purpose: Training/QA examples inspected for cognitive task, not runtime ID exceptions. Initial semantic assessments require human backtesting, not official labels.
examples: Diagnosis counts are used to infer increased illness incidence; the requested task diagnoses that inference.
Construct attainable scores under the tigdown/transformation constraint, then compare both team scores.
Find the missing dependence between wellbeing and social cohesion.
Identify the author's principal conclusion, not the supporting ageing research.
Map necessary-condition reasoning to a new argument, rather than merely name its flaw.
Determine supervising adults, split age groups, multiply tariffs, then total the bill; no substantial irrelevant dataset.
Use the sum of the five distinct placings and only the final score column; earlier race totals are unnecessary.
Select relevant recording-format/year bars to test the factual comparisons; graph presence alone is not the rationale.
Infer a supported treatment implication rather than identify the author's existing conclusion.
Assess new support for covering staffing costs and its effect on the original inference.
Derive initial components, target components, additions and their ratio. Upstream isolated-symbol issue remains independent.
Filter hardware and game requirements, discard infeasible laptops, and compare the surviving prices.
Only first-position letter membership is decisive; other lock dials are unnecessary.
Assess how additional evidence weakens the argument's preference for legal respect over protection.
Separate the forgiveness conclusion from its supporting reasons.
Apply the funding-distribution principle to a new setting.
Construct a cheapest pack/individual purchase yielding exactly twelve cans and subtract from the usual cost.
Exclude unavailable dates/discounts, then construct and compare family-plus-child and individual ticket purchases.
Analyse repeated adjacent-bit changes using a parity invariant; no large irrelevant data selection.
Transfer sufficient-condition reasoning to a new argument.
Diagnose the unjustified restriction of social conditioning to parents' and teachers' expectations.
Test whether university attainment signifies career intentions and therefore weakens the inference.
Construct a feasible activity sequence under duration, overlap and lunch constraints.
Filter flight dates/prices by lectures and minimum stay, rather than blindly choose the cheapest bars.
Recognise the same two-item discount relationship, not merely the same displayed price.
Identify the defended principal claim about local policy.
Apply a consequence-based principle to a new research-profit example.
Identify the unstated consequence-based moral premise required by the conclusion.
Work backwards through shop hours, return bus, outward bus and walking time.
Select Saturday prices, ignore other rows, then reason through contiguous tier crossings in a single purchase.
Construct feasible ribbon cutting/purchasing combinations. All listed lengths/prices may matter; a table does not justify selection.
Distinguish the author's main conclusion from four reasons.
Identify the erroneous publishing/accountability step rather than a new analogous argument.
Match elimination of one branch of a disjunction to a new argument.
Derive border count without double-counting corners, then inner dimensions and slab count.
Select relevant breakfast categories/years to check the statements; simple aggregation alone is not a non-trivial procedure.
Transform banana/orange quantities and derive the residual apple share; all three components matter, so the visual alone does not imply selection.
Apply the principle that privileged roles carry additional moral responsibilities.
Diagnose the illicit move from known biological consciousness to impossibility of machine consciousness.
Identify the author's principal claim about historical novels.
Enumerate constrained sums of up to three event scores and identify the smallest impossible total.
Filter price pairs by strictly greater than doubling, excluding equality and other rows.
Select/derive the diagnostic monthly revenue-to-sales ratios to locate a change; arithmetic alone is not a multi-step process.
Draw a supported conclusion about polling volume versus accuracy.
Compute original duration, revised weekly consumption, full weeks and remainder-day bound.
Identify the unstated trustworthiness/impartiality premise required for the regulatory conclusion.
Select destination/station times and then work backwards through the service cycle and walking constraints.
Apply the distinction between natural occurrence and moral justification.

The requested gold-medal proportion is explicitly defined; routine row sums/divisions prepare it. The decisive final task is recognising its corresponding chart, not choosing a new substantial procedure.
Strengthening and weakening are both changes in evidential support, not separate subcategories.
Match the same sculpture across top and side projections; selecting an option is not material filtering of irrelevant data.
Recognise coincident hole boundaries under reflection across the fold; no quantity or dynamic sequence is requested.
Match a planar net to the same octahedral structure after folding, preserving face adjacency.
Compare face adjacency/orientation under rotation to identify the same die; not a count of sequential turns.
Distinguish the reference population/year for a percentage decrease: select original smokers as the denominator, not the whole population. A simple ratio check is not a dependent procedure.
Match the underlying fairness rule to an option; the object is a principle, not the topology of another argument.
Sum dependent journey delays and translate the arrival between watch/room-clock references; no excess-data filtering is the core task.
Compose south, west and north relations to derive the necessary westward component despite unknown distances.
Systematically test starts of a 31-day calendar constrained to contain five Fridays, then evaluate which claimed weekday cannot occur.
Use the specified 100-minute monthly profile and compare applicable rental/unit-rate combinations, discarding dominated packages; simple independent cost checks are not a dependent procedure.
Trace each stage of the journey into distance/time graph segments; image options do not imply Relevant Selection.
Identify which supplied information is sufficient to compare two cost structures, not an argument assumption task.
Transfer first-fit-decreasing allocation from software/discs to pipe cutting; not Matching Arguments.

Compare the requested age ratio against the swimming benchmark rather than choose by raw counts. Candidate screening and applicable comparison-basis selection are material; routine ratio calculations are not an independently substantial procedure.

Recover each age group's revenue interval, divide by its entry fee to obtain visitor counts, then identify the pie chart preserving those proportions. Revenue-to-count conversion and visual correspondence are independently required.
Construct a five-night duty schedule satisfying per-person totals and no three consecutive shifts, then infer Sheila's schedule under Robert's Friday condition.

Match steady-fill depth/time gradients to vessel cross-sections; identify the unmatched shape. The decisive operation is correspondence between container and graph, not constructing an independent numerical simulation.
Truncate scores to complete hundreds, associate each person's score with their sponsorship rate and compare derived proceeds; the whole-unit rule precedes multiplication.
Model outside height through picture, unequal upper/lower mount and two frame edges. The addition formula must be constructed; it is not printed as an instruction.

The question explicitly requests monthly differences and asks which bar representation encodes them. Routine pairwise subtraction prepares the statistic; correspondence of the monthly pattern is decisive.
Recognise whether two identical copies of a token can correspond as complements of one disc, preserving the boundary relation under rotation.
Map cube-net adjacencies and face orientations onto candidate views. Numeric text answers select compatible views without changing the spatial-equivalence task.
Track the same endpoint pairing under reversal of one ranking axis, then recognise reflection symmetry about the midline. No new quantity or applicability subset is requested.

Construct net vote changes from all four directed transfers, then test March/April candidate states against those balances and the total electorate. No finished initial distribution is supplied to match directly.
